sentences.en: The team also identified two measures of the capability of MCCs to carry out warrant execution.

sentences.en: Two MCCs withdrew old breach warrants (more than 12 months ).
sentences.vi: Hai MCC đã rút lại các lệnh vi phạm cũ (hơn 12 tháng).
